statements.status_notes: OpenTelemetry API 1.62.0 removes io.opentelemetry.common.impl.ApiUsageLogger, which Elasticsearch's APM tracer depends on. Upgrading causes NoClassDefFoundError at runtime. The fix requires upstream Elasticsearch code changes to support the newer OpenTelemetry API. The vulnerability affects W3C baggage propagation with unbounded memory allocation, but most Java HTTP servers enforce 8 KiB header limits by default, mitigating external attack vectors.

CVE-2026-45292 affects io.opentelemetry/opentelemetry-api 1.29.0, a transitive dependency of jmx-exporter. Upstream fix available in version 1.62.0, but Maven dependency management does not successfully force the version upgrade for this transitive dependency. Alternative remediation approaches under investigation.

Patching opentelemetry-api to version 1.62.0 breaks Elasticsearch 8.19.13 compatibility due to removal of io.opentelemetry.common.impl.ApiUsageLogger class. The component is tightly coupled to Elasticsearch's internal APM module. Waiting for upstream Elasticsearch update that bundles a compatible fixed version.
